reviews.title: No longer supported
reviews.text: I really loved this app and used it for several years but (as you can tell from how old the reviews all are) this app is no longer supported. It won’t recognize my log in credentials and even typing in those credentials has gotten really buggy (tap one letter and the letter next to it registers instead). This app should probably be removed from the store as it is no longer supported.

reviews.title: ABSOLUTE GARBAGE, DON'T BOTHER
reviews.text:
What a complete waste of time. Can't log in, can't reset my password because their website is literally dead (Error 1016), and Facebook login says "app not active — developer is aware". Tried EVERYTHING — restarted phone, reset password, checked everything — NOTHING works. Tells you to enable calendar access but the option doesn't even exist in settings. It's broken, they know it's broken, and they've done nothing about it. Save yourself the headache — STAY AWAY.

I WISH I COULD GIVE A ZERO STAR RATING, ONE IS WAY TO KIND.

reviews.title: Terrible
